name: rishi-indian-stocks-explained
description: Animated financial-literacy series site: 730 videos across Instagram, YouTube & Facebook. Vercel + Supabase.

paragraphs: A content platform for an animated financial-literacy series: 365 daily episodes (730 short videos) that explain savings, tax, scams, insurance and investing to Indian families through recurring characters (Rishi, Priya, Paati, Murugan, Ravi). The site gathers the series across Instagram, YouTube and Facebook.
features: Automated video pipeline (Python + Pillow + FFmpeg/NVENC): procedurally animated 80-second vertical episodes with TTS narration and subtitles; 52 auto-generated 16:9 weekly compilations with chapters and thumbnails.
Multi-platform publishing: per-platform caption/metadata generators (Instagram, YouTube Shorts with SEO tags, Facebook Reels) and scheduled automation keeping each calendar filled.
Website (this repo): static, dependency-free front end (HTML/CSS/vanilla JS) deployed on Vercel; optional Supabase backend (Postgres + Row Level Security) for live episode data and a course waitlist.
Release-aware episode grid (episodes appear after their posting time), topic search, weekly compilations, bonus "earn with skills" videos, and a locked course preview.
